stem: One scouting round checks 50 plants across fixed zones; the next checks 10 plants near the door only. Why is trend interpretation weakened?
choices: Sampling effort and spatial coverage changed, so rounds are not directly comparable
More recent data are always better regardless of method
Door samples represent the entire room automatically
Negative findings do not need sampling context
rationale: Comparable scouting requires consistent or documented sampling effort and spatial coverage.
